rh.number_traceability.all_quantities_tr.reason: The great majority of quantities trace exactly to logs: fidelity MAEs 0.3551/0.3604/0.3495 -> 0.355±0.003; main valid/test 0.304±0.010 / 0.781±0.012; ECE 0.004, AUROC 0.794/0.777/0.853/0.867; operating points; K80 3/4; uncovered 4.8%; every atlas, candidate and transfer table cell; rMD17 4.0–12.6 kcal/mol; failure-analysis medians. However, Appendix B (report.tex ~l.1073–1074) makes an explicit quantitative stability claim: 'The mechanism quantities (per-order decay ratios, localisation medians) agree to within a few percent' across seeds. The submission's own per-seed outputs materially contradict it. Atom-level localisation for N=N/N=O is 2.61/53.25/4.39 (seeds 0/1/2), cumulene 0.17/0.21/10.23, N–O single 6.63/3.10/4.90, zwitterion 3.37/3.94/1.72, ≥3 N 0.63/3.11/0.92, acetal 0.97/4.19/1.13. The median localisation across the atlas is 1.26/1.86/1.55. Motif order-2 magnitudes also differ: zwitterion 1.225/1.862/0.754, azo 0.970/2.318/0.689, cumulene 1.733/0.913/0.868 kcal/mol. Only the background decay ratios (~22 and ~18–20) agree within ~4–8%. No log computes the claimed cross-seed agreement; finalize_aux.py/aux_analysis.json compute only library overlap. This claim underwrites the mechanism taxonomy: e.g. cumulene 'anti-localised (0.17)' becomes 10.23 in seed 2, and N–O's 'strongest localisation (6.6×)' is 3.10 in seed 1. So it is a material contradiction of a reported uncertainty/stability statement, not a missing source. Lesser, individually immaterial mismatches: Sec. 5 prose 0.24/1.24/0.99 vs logged D_eval 0.225/1.225/0.970, which a read-only recomputation from eval_test_peratom.npz confirmed; the abstract attributes the 6.6× localisation to 'electronic motifs' though it belongs to the N–O single bond (hetero, RR 0.89); bridgehead is grouped in 'localisation below 1 (0.26–0.58)' though its value is NaN ('--'); main-seed epochs are given as '1,106–1,300' vs 1,304 logged for seed 2.
